race.comment: JEAN GEORGES (13) is a progressive 3yo gelding. He closed off strongly behind Skua two back with current VRC Oaks favourite Miss Waititi in behind. He then went to Moe up in trip and won very nicely. Skips a grade or two here but looks capable of going on with it. MELEK (7) presents third up and ready to win out in trip. He stepped up to this trip at Ballarat and just missed, expect he goes close. RAZANNE (14) drops 5kg from a narrow miss at Kilmore last time and should kick up from an inside gate to take catching. TERRORTORIAN (8) steps up in trip off a good effort at Bendigo and should be an improver for it. PLACENTIA BAY (9) is struggling to break through but will be on speed giving a sight.
